description: Adds a voltage offset to each channel of a polyphonic cable, one knob per channel, sixteen channels in all.

params.text: Sets the offset added to that channel, as an exact voltage, in semitone steps of a twelfth of a volt, or in whole volts, as set on the menu.

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal the offsets are added to; with nothing patched the knobs produce the output on their own.

outputs.text: The input with each channel's offset added.

menu: Channels — sets how many channels the output carries; on Automatic it matches the number arriving at the input.
Knob mode — Volt sets each knob as an exact voltage, Semitone in steps of a twelfth of a volt, and Octave in whole volts.
